library.scene: A three-storey cutaway old public library in present day Kediri at rainy midnight. Ground floor circulation desk and glass entrance, middle floor tall bookshelves and rolling ladders, attic archive with a round window. Iron stairs on right, warm reading lamps against violet-blue rain outside, modern city silhouettes beyond windows. All three floors visible as a theatrical side elevation.

market.scene: Tiered Pasar Tandes market on the Brantas river in imagined ancient East Java. Bamboo stalls with thatch roofs and pottery at ground level, upper rice storage platforms linked by rope bridges, rooftops forming a third traversal route. Boats on the river, distant Kelud mountain at orange dawn, hanging textiles and fishing nets. Rich Indonesian local visual identity.

hill.scene: A tall vertical cutaway of misty blue Mount Klotok forest and Selomangleng cave in imagined East Java. Bottom: banyan roots and mossy rock ledges rising up a waterfall. Middle: cave entrance with relief carvings and a warm small oil lamp. Top: dark stacked meditation chambers, gold reflected light, deep indigo rock. A view of the Brantas valley in distant background. No people.

gate.scene: A monumental red brick East Javanese paduraksa gateway at the centre, dwarapala statues on either side, left guardhouse and water jars, right multi-storey watchtower and bronze mirror platform, small locked storehouse, royal rooftops behind the wall. Warm copper sunset and long shadows. Pure side elevation, rooms shown in cutaway.

palace.scene: An ancient East Javanese royal palace cutaway with three levels visible. Ground floor open pendapa with four gigantic carved soko guru timber pillars and hanging bronze bells. Right two-storey gandok side chambers, roof attic with heirloom cabinets. Faded gold, silent grey-blue twilight, torches casting warm triangular light, thin silk curtains and incense.

bedroom.scene: A quiet intimate East Javanese princess bedroom in a royal palace, pure side view cutaway. Carved low wooden daybed on right, ivory silk curtains, bronze dressing mirror and manuscript table on left, open window showing a blue moon. Warm gold oil lamps, soft ivory cloth and dark teak. A small calm space after a storm. Empty room, no people.

mbok.character: A kind elderly East Javanese woman, Mbok Rondo Dadapan, humble brown batik skirt, cream shoulder shawl, dark hair bun with grey strands, holding a woven basket of food. Three-quarter side view facing right, full body, standing.

kilisuci.character: Dewi Kilisuci, a serene adult East Javanese ascetic woman, simple ivory and faded ochre robes, dark long hair tied back, bare feet, modest small gold forehead ornament, gentle upright standing pose, three-quarter side view facing left, full body.

ki-samar.character: Ki Samar, a weary ordinary human male archivist in a dark charcoal-purple hooded robe, holding a rolled manuscript and a pen, stooped contemplative stance, face partly visible with tired kind brown eyes, nonviolent, no weapons, three-quarter side view facing left, full body.

putri.character: Princess Candra Kirana, dignified adult East Javanese princess, warm brown skin, long dark hair, restrained gold traditional head ornament, ivory and golden batik wrap garment, gold arm jewellery, calm standing pose, three-quarter side view facing left, full body. No weapons.

lutung.character: One small black Javan langur monkey with a long curling tail, crouching side view facing right, holding a little cloth food bundle. Friendly mischievous expression, whole body and entire tail visible.
